top_signals.title: Meta to open source its most powerful AI model as it takes swipe at OpenAI, Anthropic
top_signals.summary: Meta launched Muse Glimmer and plans to release Muse Spark 1.2 weights as Zuckerberg pushes for U.S. leadership in open AI.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Europe Stocks Poised to 'Grind Higher,' BNP Paribas Says
top_signals.summary: Benedicte Lowe, Europe equity derivates strategist at BNP Paribas Markets 360, says it's "undeniable that the macro story is picking up in Europe," and that means "positive picture for stocks." She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT 5.6 Cyber, but it's only for approved users
top_signals.summary: OpenAI has developed a new model called "GPT 5.6 Cyber," designed for vulnerability research, penetration testing, incident response, and remediation. [...]
